replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Nice one laddie. First and foremost, I have a whopping amount of *enough* neurons! Sorry, bud.  Back on topic how do you explain Marteo_ matching with your IP? Calling the people you want to make  ammends with stupid is a terrible way to repair your relations with the server. Unless you can prove why your IP's match then please kindly take your frustrations elsewhere. Secondly, I was told by a user that you repeatedly spammed their IP address in chat. This is NOT allowed in any form on any service of Avicus. Hence you will not be unbanned from Teamspeak as our punishment is justified. 
-Iron
